codes.name: PROTOCOL
codes.when: A message out of place or malformed: a text message where binary is expected or the reverse, an unknown type byte, content that fails its schema, a REQUEST while another is in flight, a page socket without the portal Origin.

codes.name: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION
codes.when: A version byte or AUTH version other than 1.

codes.name: AUTH_FAILED
codes.when: Engine socket only: basalt-engine-key is not a P-256 SPKI or does not hash to the engine id, or AUTH's signature fails or comes late.

codes.name: REPLACED
codes.when: Engine socket only: a newer authenticated socket for the same engine id took over.

codes.name: LINK_UNKNOWN
codes.when: Page socket: no engine registered the token, it expired, or the engine unregistered it.

codes.name: ENGINE_OFFLINE
codes.when: Page socket: the engine that registered the token has no socket now.

codes.name: LINK_REFUSED
codes.when: Handshake message 1 for a token the engine does not hold, an expired or revoked link, a token other than SESSION_OPEN's, a tag that fails (wrong psk), or an invalid ephemeral key (checked after the tag). All answer alike. Also open sessions of a link the engine revokes or that expires.

codes.name: HANDSHAKE_FAILED
codes.when: An engine ephemeral key that is not a valid uncompressed P-256 point; message 2 that does not decrypt, whose payload fails its schema, or whose signature fails; on DIRECT, an engine key other than the pinned one.

codes.name: FRAME_INVALID
codes.when: A frame that does not decrypt with the next counter (dropped, repeated, reordered, reflected or from another session), or whose padding is not canonical.

codes.name: TOO_LARGE
codes.when: A message over its size limit, or a response body over 16 MiB.

codes.name: RATE_LIMITED
codes.when: Too many handshakes for a link, requests in a session, or connections at the Vault.

codes.name: SESSION_LIMIT
codes.when: Too many open sessions for the link or for the engine.

codes.name: TIMEOUT
codes.when: The handshake did not finish in 10 seconds, the session was idle 5 minutes, or it reached 30 minutes or its link's expiry.

codes.name: ENGINE_REVOKED
codes.when: The engine's key is revoked in the person's database (M4.1); the engine serves no session.

codes.name: ENGINE_SHUTDOWN
codes.when: The engine is stopping, or its keys were rotated.
